Software Engineer, Cloud Services
Description -
Who We Are
HP IQ is HP’s new AI innovation lab. Combining startup agility with HP’s global scale, we’re building intelligent technologies that redefine how the world works, creates, and collaborates.
We’re assembling a diverse, world-class team—engineers, designers, researchers, and product minds—focused on creating an intelligent ecosystem across HP’s portfolio. Together, we’re developing intuitive, adaptive solutions that spark creativity, boost productivity, and make collaboration seamless.
We create breakthrough solutions that make complex tasks feel effortless, teamwork more natural, and ideas more impactful—always with a human-centric mindset.
By embedding AI advancements into every HP product and service, we’re expanding what’s possible for individuals, organisations, and the future of work.
Join us as we reinvent work, so people everywhere can do their best work.
About The Role
As a Software Engineer, Cloud Services, you will create scalable, reliable backend systems that support HP IQ's mission to transform the way people work. We value how we work as much as what we deliver. Our journey of continuous learning and evolution requires a flexible and resilient services platform that fosters innovation, experimentation, and adaptation. To enable this, we focus on designs and tools rooted in strong engineering principles like abstraction, composition, virtualization, automation, and iterative development cycles.
What You Might Do
Design, develop, and maintain backend services and RESTful APIs using Java and Spring Boot.
Write clean, efficient, and well-tested code following established best practices.
Collaborate with frontend developers, product managers, and other engineers to deliver end-to-end features.
Integrate with databases and external services, ensuring performance, security, and reliability.
Participate in code reviews, debugging, and performance optimization efforts.
Contribute to CI/CD pipelines and support application deployment in cloud and local environments.
Essential Qualifications
8+ years of professional software development experience.
Strong proficiency in Java and Spring Boot.
Experience building RESTful APIs and microservices.
Familiarity with relational databases such as MySQL or PostgreSQL.
Understanding of version control systems, preferably Git.
Knowledge of unit testing frameworks and debugging practices.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
Familiarity with Docker and containerized deployments.
Experience building private cloud workflow.
Understanding of distributed systems and scalable architecture.
Salary: $107,400-$155,700

hp-3170345.text:
Firmware Engineer
Description -
HP is seeking an experienced Embedded Security Engineer to drive the development, integration, and evolution of security technologies for enterprise printing products.
This role focuses on platform security solutions, including Smart Card authentication, PKI-based security services, and Supplies Security (Gauss) technologies . The successful candidate will lead security architecture, firmware development, platform integration, and security validation activities throughout the product lifecycle.
The ideal candidate will bring expertise in embedded security, cryptography, secure firmware development, and system-level problem solving while contributing to HP's next-generation security platform strategy.
Responsibilities
Lead the architecture, design, implementation, and lifecycle management of security-related firmware and platform services.
Develop and maintain Smart Card authentication solutions, including CAC/PIV workflows, certificate management, PIN-based authentication, and enterprise identity integration.
Drive development and integration of Supplies Security (Gauss) technologies, including security firmware, middleware, device drivers, and platform interfaces.
Design and implement cryptographic services, secure storage, key management, and authentication mechanisms.
Port, integrate, and maintain third-party security solutions and middleware within embedded firmware platforms.
Define security architecture, threat models, validation strategies, and secure software development practices.
Lead security verification, debugging, root-cause analysis, and resolution of complex firmware, hardware, and platform security issues.
Collaborate with firmware, hardware, QA, operating system, and security teams to ensure secure and reliable product delivery.
Work directly with external technology partners and vendors to support solution integration, issue resolution, and long-term technology planning.
Collaborate and communicate with management, internal, and outsourced development partners regarding firmware design status, project progress, and issue resolution.
Stay up to date with industry trends and advancements in firmware and security technologies and provide recommendations for improvement.
Impact & Scope
Impacts multiple teams and may act as a team or project leader, providing direction to team activities and facilitating information validation and team decision-making processes.
Complexity
Responds to moderately complex issues within established guidelines.
Leadership Expectations
Provide technical leadership in strategic security technology areas.
Drive architecture decisions and long-term technology direction.
Mentor engineers and contribute to the growth of team technical capabilities.
Work effectively across global engineering organizations.
Communicate complex technical concepts clearly to both engineering and business stakeholders.
Minimum Qualifications
Education: Four-year or Graduate Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Electrical Engineering, or any other related discipline or commensurate work experience or demonstrated competence.
4+ years of work experience or an advanced degree with 3+ years of work experience in:
Strong experience in embedded software or firmware development using C/C++.
Solid understanding of security architecture, authentication technologies, and secure firmware development.
Experience with cryptographic technologies, PKI, certificate management, and secure authentication mechanisms.
Experience integrating security solutions into commercial embedded products.
Strong debugging and problem-solving skills across firmware, hardware, and system integration layers.
Preferred Qualifications
Smart Card / Platform Security
Experience with Smart Card technologies, including CAC/PIV authentication, certificate validation, and enterprise identity integration.
Knowledge of PKI infrastructure, X.509 certificates, CRL/CDP processing, and secure access workflows.
Supplies Security (Gauss)
Experience with security chip technologies, device drivers, middleware, and platform integration.
Familiarity with secure storage, key management, cryptographic validation, and hardware-based security architecture.
Additional Preferences
Experience working with enterprise firmware platforms.
Familiarity with commercial printing or imaging products.
Experience collaborating with global engineering teams and external technology partners..
Benefits
The pay range for this role is $105,050 to $161,800 USD annually with additional opportunities for pay in the form of bonus and/or equity (applies to United States of America candidates only). Pay varies by work location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.
HP offers a comprehensive benefits package for this position, including:

Dental insurance
Vision insurance
Long term/short term disability insurance
Employee assistance program
Flexible spending account
Life insurance
Generous time off policies, including;
4-12 weeks fully paid parental leave based on tenure
11 paid holidays
Additional flexible paid vacation and sick leave ( US benefits overview )
The compensation and benefits information is accurate as of the date of this posting. The Company reserves the right to modify this information at any time, with or without notice, subject to applicable law.

This job description describes the general nature and level of work performed in this role. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, skills, responsibilities, knowledge, etc. These may be subject to change and additional functions may be assigned as needed by management.

Software Engineering Intern, Product & Developer Productivity - HP IQ
Description -
HP IQ's Product Integrity & Developer Productivity team is responsible for building next-generation tools and systems that improve developer productivity and product quality at scale. We are specifically investing in agentic systems that automate complex workflows, from intelligent JIRA triage and root-cause analysis to test planning and quality automation. In this internship role, you will work directly with our hiring manager and team to design, build, and deploy agents that utilize pre-trained machine learning models to solve real problems for developers and quality engineers. This is an exceptional opportunity to be part of a team navigating the fundamental shift toward agentic development and to contribute meaningfully to tools that thousands of developers will rely on.
What You Might Do
As an intern on our team, you'll contribute to real-world engineering projects that explore how AI can improve the way software is built, tested, and maintained. Depending on business priorities and your team's needs, you may have the opportunity to:
Design, build, and iterate on AI-powered tools and workflows that improve engineering productivity.
Develop intelligent systems that help automate software development, testing, debugging, or quality assurance processes.
Prototype and evaluate new approaches for applying large language models (LLMs) and agentic AI to solve complex engineering challenges.
Collaborate with software engineers, machine learning engineers, product managers, designers, and other cross-functional partners to deliver impactful solutions.
Participate in technical design discussions, code reviews, and collaborative problem-solving sessions.
Analyze technical challenges, propose innovative solutions, and contribute fresh ideas that improve products, tools, and engineering workflows.
Build, test, and iterate on production-quality software while learning modern engineering best practices.
Present your work, share technical learnings, and contribute to a collaborative engineering culture.
Essential Qualifications
Currently pursuing or recently completed a bachelor's or graduate degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
Solid understanding of coding fundamentals and comfort with at least one programming language; you should be able to learn new languages and frameworks as needed.
Familiarity with agentic systems, AI tools (such as Claude Code or OpenAI), or model utilization in applications; deep machine learning expertise is not required as we focus on using pre-trained models, not building them.
Ability to break down complex problems into manageable steps and solve them independently while knowing when to ask for help.
Willingness to question established processes and propose alternative approaches; comfort in an environment that values fresh thinking and continuous improvement.
Strong communication skills; ability to explain your reasoning clearly and articulate the logic behind your technical choices.
Familiarity with software development workflows, quality assurance, testing practices, or developer tooling (helpful but not required).
Preferred Skills
Experience building or working with automation tools or systems that improve workflow efficiency.
Exposure to or familiarity with JIRA, continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD) systems, or testing frameworks.
Experience working in cross-functional teams or in environments where you collaborated with people from different technical backgrounds.
Understanding or coursework in machine learning, AI, or agent systems.
Example projects demonstrating agentic thinking, such as personal projects using AI tools to automate tasks.
Hourly Pay Range: $40.00–$50.00 per hour. Actual compensation will be determined based on factors such as skills, qualifications, and experience.

hp-uni4800.text:
Software Engineering Intern, AIML Platform - HP IQ
Description -
HP IQ's AI Machine Learning (AML) team is building the foundational platform powering a new generation of agentic devices. This platform orchestrates the complete lifecycle of AI models: from creation and fine-tuning through optimized inference and intelligent orchestration. The team works to make complex AI capabilities run efficiently on-device, enabling locally-deployed agentic experiences that reduce token costs and improve privacy. In this internship role, you will contribute to one or more core pillars of the AML platform: model inference optimization, orchestration and agent workflows, or model creation and fine-tuning. You will partner closely with experienced engineers to ship features that directly impact HP's next-generation devices and gain visibility into how each component of an end-to-end AI system integrates and scales.
What You Might Do
Work on model hosting and inference optimization, learning how to profile, benchmark, and accelerate model execution on resource-constrained devices; experiment with quantization, distillation, or other optimization techniques to reduce latency and memory footprint.
Contribute to orchestration frameworks and agent workflows, building or extending systems that coordinate multiple models and agents using tools like LangGraph or LangChain; develop an understanding of when agentic patterns are appropriate and how to design robust, scalable orchestrations.
Participate in model customization and fine-tuning, taking pre-trained language models and adapting them for specific use cases; conduct experiments, evaluate results, and iterate on model configurations to improve performance for target tasks.
Collaborate cross-functionally with system software, design, and product teams to understand how your work integrates into the broader platform; communicate progress, challenges, and technical decisions clearly and seek mentorship from engineers with deep expertise in your focus area.
Contribute to open-source projects or internal libraries relevant to inference, orchestration, or model training; demonstrate ownership of end-to-end outcomes and ownership of improving the platform's capabilities and reliability.
Essential Qualifications
Currently pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field, or equivalent practical experience. Some coursework or project experience in machine learning, systems engineering, or software development is expected.
Demonstrated technical communication skills: ability to articulate project goals, outcomes, challenges, and technical decisions clearly; comfort explaining technical concepts to peers and mentors.
Genuine familiarity with one or more of the following: model inference and optimization, orchestration frameworks (LangGraph, LangChain), model fine-tuning and adaptation, or similar systems-level AI work. Project experience, open-source contributions, or course projects demonstrating depth in at least one area are highly valued.
Collaboration and ownership mindset: comfort working in cross-functional teams, asking for help when needed, and taking responsibility for outcomes; ability to operate with some ambiguity and seek clarity proactively.
Problems-solving orientation: ability to debug issues, evaluate technical tradeoffs, and make reasonable decisions when multiple approaches are viable.
Preferred Skills
Open-source contributions to inference engines (e.g., vLLM), model repositories, or orchestration libraries; demonstrated ability to contribute meaningfully to a shared codebase.
Experience with Python and ML-adjacent libraries (PyTorch, TensorFlow, Hugging Face, FastAPI, or similar).
Familiarity with on-device or edge AI constraints and optimization techniques.
Experience with system-level profiling and performance optimization.
Hourly Pay Range: $40.00–$50.00 per hour. Actual compensation will be determined based on factors such as skills, qualifications, and experience.

Software Engineering Intern, Connectivity - HP IQ
Description -
About The Role
HP IQ's Connectivity Software team is building foundational software that enables the next generation of connected experiences across devices and platforms. Our team works at the intersection of systems software, wireless connectivity, and emerging technologies to create seamless, intelligent experiences. We are looking for an Intern to join the team and contribute to the software, protocols, and systems that bring these experiences to life.
In this role, you will work alongside experienced engineers to develop on-device software for next-generation HP IQ experiences. You’ll contribute to the design, development, and implementation of software across emerging devices and platforms. This is a hands-on technical role where you’ll write code, solve complex system-level problems, and collaborate with engineers to explore and build new experiences.
What You Might Do
Develop on-device firmware and system software in C, C++, or Python for connected device experiences.
Build and enhance software supporting wireless connectivity across a variety of devices and platforms.
Explore sensing, machine learning, and AI techniques to solve complex technical challenges.
Debug and resolve issues across system software, wireless connectivity, and application-level code.
Collaborate with hardware and software engineers to understand requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
Participate in code reviews and technical design discussions, learning from and contributing to the broader engineering team.
Contribute to the testing, validation, and documentation of software and firmware features.
Essential Qualifications
Write efficient on-device firmware and system software in C, C++, or Python to implement wireless connectivity protocols (Wi-Fi, Bluetooth) across multiple device types.
Design and implement device-to-device discovery and pairing protocols that enable seamless communication in enterprise and consumer environments.
Optimize machine learning inference on resource-constrained devices, balancing model accuracy against power consumption and latency constraints.
Develop sensing algorithms that leverage data and AI techniques to enable new ambient and wearable interactions.
Debug and resolve complex issues spanning the wireless stack, operating system integration, and application-level code.
Collaborate with hardware engineers, system software teams, and product managers to understand requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
Participate in code reviews and design discussions, learning from and contributing insights to the team's technical direction.
Contribute to testing, validation, and documentation of connectivity features and firmware updates.
Preferred Skills
Previous experience with edge machine learning or AI inference on embedded devices.
Familiarity with IoT or ambient computing paradigms.
Experience shipping consumer software products from development through production.
Background in IoT, wearable, or mobile device development.
Exposure to agentic workflows or multi-device ecosystem design.

Description -
Job Description
This is an Entry-level Product Engineering position within HP’s imaging and printing business. Our print technology includes the merging of complex design constraints, the use of material combinations, and extensive product testing/qualification to deliver high quality products that provide excellent end user performance. This includes the combination and interaction of polymers, ceramics, metals, elastomers, multilayer films and electronics using mechanical, fluidic, electrical, adhesion, thermal, and chemical manufacturing processes. A product engineer monitors these processes to ensure product requirements are met or exceeded.
NPI Entry Product Engineering – What you will do
Understand customer (product) and manufacturing (process) requirements. Partner with R&D to define quality requirements.
Develop and characterize quality systems & test methods to minimize or eliminate risks and ensure the product meets the end-customer quality requirements. Using DOE characterization and subsequent results, refine specifications end-to-end (product to process) to ensure a shippable product. This includes material, process, and other variations.
Partner with Southeast Asia high-volume counterparts to drive NPI transfer activities to high-volume manufacturing sites.
Manage the qualification of change of the released product. Triage proto and production parts to determine the cause of failure. Drive root cause evaluation and issue resolution as problems arise in proto and production.
Partner with other organizations to drive product investigations/issue escalations for released products.
Understand data connectivity methods used in part tracking within and across factories. Work with IT partners to ensure data connectivity exists and that data retrieval is operationally correct as materials and parts/assemblies move from one factory to another, often across borders and continents.
Access databases to retrieve needed critical process and product data using scripting tools to do so.
Partner and support other key organizations such as the Fab, equipment/tooling design teams, product engineering, and printer teams.
Assist with Design for Manufacturability (DFM) and Development Effectiveness in new product development to reduce risk at the launch of new products.
Collaborate with process and supply chain partners to design and complete margin studies to ensure we have a clear path to stability. Deliver clear documentation, reporting, and communication of your work.
Ensure the capture of critical knowledge & conduct knowledge transfer.
Qualifications
Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Chemical or Materials Engineering.
Experience: 0-2 years in product engineering or similar engineering activities (Systems Interactions engineering, Writing Systems engineering).
Leadership: Ability to work across organizations, including using influence to ensure all decisions are centered around customer quality. Ability to work with a team or product engineers to drive towards a common set of objectives.
Desirable skills as follows
Solid understanding of physics and core engineering materials.
Ability to broadly contribute in a fast-paced, industrial R&D environment.
Excellent communication and teamwork skills. Good planning, organizational, and documentation skills.
Ability to give clear and effective presentations to inform and persuade peers and managers. Experience in CREO 3D/2D.

The ideal candidate will bring strong knowledge of connectivity stack and hands-on experience developing, integrating, and optimizing device software to deliver industry-leading user experiences. You will work at the intersection of Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, and emerging device-to-device transport technologies, tackling complex challenges in performance, reliability, and low-latency communication. This role offers the opportunity to contribute to cutting-edge innovations that are redefining how people and devices seamlessly connect across the modern enterprise.

Implement, optimize, and tune wireless networking protocols and sensing algorithms with a focus on enterprise-scale architectures and deployments.

Collaborate closely with wireless chipset vendors, industry partners, and internal engineering teams to align designs, debug system-level issues, and optimize end-to-end connectivity performance.
Analyze and troubleshoot complex wireless behavior including performance degradation, QoS bottlenecks, interoperability issues, and security constraints in large-scale networks.

Strong programming skills in Java, C, C++, or Objective-C, with solid grounding in software engineering fundamentals (OO design, debugging, system-level architecture).
Familiarity with radio standards such as 802.11 and Bluetooth, and an understanding of related protocol stacks.
Experience collaborating across hardware, OS, QA, and cross-functional engineering teams.
Ability to work independently, drive technical tasks to closure, and clearly communicate root-cause findings to senior leadership and partners.
Preferred Skills
Proficiency in C/C++ and embedded systems programming for performance-critical wireless features.
Strong understanding of peer-to-peer technologies and sensing techniques.
Experience working directly with wireless chipset vendors to optimize connectivity performance and resolve interoperability issues.
Comfort working across diverse platforms including Linux, Windows, embedded systems, cloud-managed networks, and mobile OS stacks.
Expertise in wireless performance analysis using tools such as Wireshark, logging frameworks, and low-level tracing.

Firmware Engineer
Description -
This role is responsible for driving design, development, and debugging of embedded software/firmware for hardware, ensuring efficient and reliable operation. The role collaborates with hardware engineers to integrate software and firmware with hardware components, ensuring seamless communication and functionality. The role works closely with software developers, hardware engineers, quality assurance, and product managers to deliver high-quality products.
Responsibilities
Design and develop reliable, cost-effective, and high-quality firmware solutions for HP Print products.
Design enhancements, updates, and innovations for subsystems of embedded software running on Real-Time Operating Systems (RTOS).
Implement coding, programming, and integration activities based on product objectives and overall system architecture.
Collaborate with hardware engineers to integrate firmware with hardware components and ensure seamless system functionality.
Write and execute testing plans, protocols, and documentation for assigned software and firmware components.
Identify, debug, and resolve application and firmware issues through root-cause analysis and implementation of robust solutions.
Analyze performance, memory utilization, and power consumption profiles and implement optimizations.
Investigate field issues and deliver reliable corrective actions and long-term fixes.
Collaborate and communicate with management, internal teams, and outsourced development partners regarding software design status, project progress, and issue resolution.
Work closely with architects, hardware engineers, software developers, quality assurance teams, and product managers to ensure requirements and specifications are clearly defined.
Evaluate and apply AI-assisted software development and engineering tools when they can improve productivity, code quality, testing, debugging, documentation, or engineering workflows while meeting applicable security and intellectual property requirements.
Act as a contributing team member by providing technical analysis, recommendations, and support for team objectives.
Stay current with industry trends and emerging firmware technologies and recommend opportunities for innovation and continuous improvement.
Impact & Scop e
Impacts multiple teams and may act as a team or project leader providing direction to team activities and facilitating information validation and team decision-making processes.
Complexity
Responds to moderately complex issues within established guidelines.
Minimum Qualifications
Four-year or Graduate Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or another related discipline, or equivalent work experience and demonstrated competence.
4+ years of experience in firmware development, embedded software engineering, or a related field, or an advanced degree with 3+ years of relevant experience.
Required Knowledge & Skills
Strong programming skills in C and C++.
Experience developing firmware and embedded software solutions.
Understanding of firmware and hardware design principles.
Experience or understanding of firmware development tools, programming environments, and debugging techniques.
Working knowledge of Linux and operating systems concepts.
Understanding of Real-Time Operating Systems (RTOS), including multithreading and multitasking concepts.
Experience with software debugging, testing methodologies, and tools such as Google Test.
Familiarity with Agile methodologies and development tools such as Jira.
Experience using Git or other version control systems.
Understanding of Python scripting is beneficial.
Knowledge of algorithms, software engineering, and new product development processes.
Familiarity with ARM processors, board support packages (BSPs), and low-level device drivers is considered a plus.
Ability to analyze system performance, memory utilization, and power optimization opportunities.
Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to work effectively across global and cross-functional teams.
Passion for research, innovation, and product development in a collaborative environment.
Required Cross-Org Skills
Effective Communication
Results Orientation
Learning Agility
Digital Fluency
Customer Centricity
